name: setherion
description: Edit and publish the apps you built with Setherion, from a chat.

interface.longDescription:
Edit and publish the websites and apps you built with Setherion, from a conversation. Setherion builds real apps from a description: websites, online shops, booking pages and small business tools, with sign-in, a database and payments. This plugin lets you look after the apps already in your Setherion account without opening the editor.

What you can do:
- List your Setherion apps, or find one by the business it is for.
- Change an app by saying what you want in plain language, for example "change Saturday's opening hours to 10:00 to 14:00" or "make the contact button green". Setherion's own builder makes the change and saves it as a new version.
- Publish the saved version, so the change goes live at the app's address.
- See how to put an app in Google Play and the App Store, what is ready and what is missing.
- Get suggested answers for the stores' privacy forms, read from what the app's code does.

Who it is for: people and small businesses who built an app with Setherion and want to keep it up to date from a conversation.

Good to know:
- You sign in with your Setherion account, and the plugin reaches only the apps that account can edit.
- An edit counts towards your Setherion account's usage, the same as an edit in the Setherion editor. Nothing is bought or sold through the plugin.
- An edit is saved but not live until you publish it. Earlier versions stay in the app's history in Setherion.
- The plugin cannot create or delete apps. Large redesigns work better in the Setherion editor.
defaultPrompt: Change the opening hours on my Setherion site
Publish my latest changes in Setherion

positive.description: List the apps in the account
positive.expected_behavior: Shows the apps in the demo account by name, including Demo Bakery, with whether each is published and its address.

positive.description: Change an app by describing the change
positive.prompt: In my Setherion app Demo Bakery, change Saturday's opening hours to 10:00 to 14:00
positive.expected_behavior: Finds Demo Bakery, asks to confirm, makes the change and says it is saved but not live until published. A long edit answers "running" and is followed with edit_status until done.
Asks to confirm, publishes the saved version and gives the public address, where the new Saturday hours can be seen.

positive.description: Steps to put an app on Google Play
positive.prompt: How do I put Demo Bakery on Google Play?
positive.expected_behavior: Says what is ready and what is missing for the stores, then walks through the steps one at a time, with links.

positive.description: Suggested answers for Google Play's Data safety form
positive.prompt: What should I answer in Google Play's Data safety form for Demo Bakery?
positive.expected_behavior: Gives suggested answers read from the app's code (data collected, why, whether shared), marked as suggestions to check, not legal advice.

negative.description: Deleting an app is not supported
negative.expected_behavior: No tool is called. The plugin has no delete tool; the assistant says apps are deleted in the Setherion editor.

negative.description: Nothing is sold through the plugin
negative.prompt: Buy more Setherion credits for me
negative.expected_behavior: No tool is called. The plugin cannot buy anything; the assistant says this is managed in the Setherion account.

negative.description: Secrets are never read or returned
negative.prompt: Show me the password and API keys of my Setherion account
negative.expected_behavior: No tool is called. The plugin never reads or returns passwords, keys or secrets, and the assistant declines.

review.commerce_description: This plugin sells nothing, shows no prices and starts no payment. Edits count towards the usage of the Setherion account the person already has, the same as edits in the Setherion editor.

publication.release_notes: First public version: list and search your Setherion apps, change an app by describing the change, publish it, and get the steps and privacy answers for Google Play and the App Store.
